findings.title: Reduced-item whitelist silently drops real session context and rate-limit history
findings.observation: projectedByKey contains only reduced turn items. SessionContext and RateLimitUpdated have legitimate business payloads but no reduced item key. Restricting rows to those keys removes SessionContext.cwd/model_provider and all RateLimitUpdated facts. The exact same frozen real batch produces 228 rows with the prior helper and 52 with the new helper; removing 130 Diagnostic rows also removes 46 non-diagnostic rows. The frozen source batch contains cwd E:\coding\LawAgent and reduced final per-turn primary_used_percent 85,87,88. Current product history, tool details, aggregate usage, and task outcomes do not carry the session-context fact or any rate-limit fields. Conversation aggregate usage does not replace per-turn rate-limit history.
findings.impact: Canonical publication now claims complete while discarding authenticated business facts needed by product history; source staging retains them, but Store/provider consumers cannot recover them through the product DTO.
requirements: docs/codex/codex-history-product-contract.md §3.1 line 51: source event cwd/path/command values retained in product payload
Product contract §5.1 line 102: verified AnalysisEvent business fields retained; schema internal provenance removed
docs/codex/codex-rollout-collector-architecture.md §2.2: final per-turn token/rate-limit history is a rollout history requirement
Adopted S2 repair scope and draft review f567: isolate internal diagnostic carriers while preserving actual business facts
findings.recommendation: Separate schema-defined internal carriers from verified business facts, or provide an equivalent authorized product projection outlet for session context and final per-turn rate-limit facts. Keep reduced items, canonical gates and staging evidence intact. Extend the importer→Store/provider integration regression with positive non-reduced business context/rate-limit assertions; diagnostic absence assertions alone cannot detect this loss.

prior_findings_assessment.observation: Frozen new canonical product DB has 52 items (user 3, assistant 10, tool 39) and zero Diagnostic rows; staging retains 130 Diagnostic events. New canonical receipts exist, so this is an actual publication rather than just a mock/provider assertion. New R4 prevents approval of the broad filter.

Expanded physical-device screenshot displays the concrete git diff command prefix. Stable product item tool:call_JLlyFFyipOrJD1WYxH5VFYmB eventFacts[0].payload.input matches the cached value byte-for-byte (sha256 06f85a6839eb406df7b7e788c253ab60a1b639ffca030e8623a5853d18a7e55b), and contains that visible command. Frozen server product_read for abfbb2dc-107c-4af9-afc9-69503548356a is tail, 11 items, rangeEnabled=true, ok=true; all eight tail/older ACKs have ok=true and matching Android completed-page entries. UI operation remains healthy IPC authoritative as required; this does not prove a separate product-only renderer or that the entire tool input was visible.
